source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the median (PDF 191-192).

blocks.text: Median tarteeb diye data ki darmiyani qeemat hai. Agar qeematon ki tadaad taaq ho to beech wali qeemat; juft ho to do darmiyani qeematon ki ausat. Hayatiyat mein yeh aabadi ka size, bimari ki sharah ya jismani naap jaisi cheezon mein, jahan data normal taqseem mein na ho, mean se behtar markaz dikhata hai. Koi aik formula nahi, sirf qadam hain.

items: Data ko barhti ya ghat'ti tarteeb mein rakhein.
Agar n taaq ho to median (n + 1) / 2 wali jagah ki qeemat hai.
Agar n juft ho to median n / 2 aur n / 2 + 1 jaghon ki qeematon ki ausat hai.

blocks.text: Taaq tadaad: paudon ki unchaiyan 50, 65, 60, 75 aur 80 cm. Tarteeb: 50, 60, 65, 75, 80; n = 5; median teesri qeemat, 65 cm. Juft tadaad: janwaron ke wazan 300, 400, 330, 315, 450 aur 500 kg. Tarteeb: 300, 315, 330, 400, 450, 500; n = 6; median teesri aur chauthi qeemat ki ausat, (330 + 400) / 2 = 365 kg.

blocks.prompt: Chhe bachchon ki unchaiyan 110, 115, 118, 120, 122 aur 125 cm hain. Median kya hai?
blocks.explanation: n = 6 juft hai, is liye median teesri aur chauthi qeemat ki ausat hai: (118 + 120) / 2 = 119 cm.

items: Data tarteeb dein; taaq n: beech ki qeemat; juft n: do darmiyani qeematon ki ausat.
